observations.summary: PolicyView.guard.test.tsx adds mounted wallet-attempt clear/retry regression evidence to the already known Pay route coverage. It is incorrect to state that recovery has no route test.
observations.limitation: Assertions were read, not executed. Their existence does not show affected privacy heads pass.

observations.summary: The assigned PolicyView suites exercise session/key changes, network revocation, Web Lock queuing and duplicate recovery, but do not contain a mounted test editing the transaction terms while the send operation is awaiting. Existing unpinned-deployment tests preserve the latent/inactive qualification.
observations.limitation: A test coverage observation, not a new production finding or runtime result.

observations.summary: The assigned ReceiptPanel and receipt-codec suites do not validate the combined application print cascade or rendered print output. Their receipt identity, signature, consent, archive and localization assertions do not resolve the prior global print CSS finding.
